ov: أمل (الكورية: 호프) هو فلم خيال علمي وإثارة كوري جنوبي، من إخراج وسيناريو نا هونغ جين. ومن بطولة هوانغ جونغ مين و‌زو إن سونغ و‌جونغ هو يون و‌أليسيا فيكاندر و‌مايكل فاسبندر و‌تايلور راسل و‌كاميرون بريتون. في أبريل 2026، دُعي الفلم للمنافسة على جائزة السعفة الذهبية في مهرجان كان السينمائي 2026، ليصبح بذلك أول فلم كوري جنوبي يشارك في المسابقة الرسمية منذ أربع سنوات.
plotEn:
Ko Bum-seok is the police chief of Hope Harbor, a small village near the Korean Demilitarized Zone populated mostly by elderly residents. His second cousin, Ko Sung-ki, asks him to inspect a dead cow with gaping wounds. Sung-ki and his fellow hunters attribute it to a stray tiger, but soon find further dead cattle and the farm's owner also dead. Bum-seok returns to a Hope Harbor in distress as a large creature rampages across the village, massacring several villagers. With reinforcements tied up fighting wildfires elsewhere, he teams up with retired colonel Ahn Nak-yeon to track it down, but the pair mistakenly shoot and badly wound a local chef while searching a dilapidated building. 
Continuing the search alone, Bum-seok learns from a local militia that the creature is in fact an intelligent, apparently indestructible humanoid. After it wipes out the militia, rookie officer Im Sung-ae saves Bum-seok by firing a grenade launcher at the creature, severing one of its legs. The two give chase by car, but Bum-seok hesitates to finish the creature off after seeing it crying. The creature is killed after being run over by a tanker.
A surgeon examines the body, noting that it is a digitigrade with similarities to human anatomy but also additional unknown organs. Bum-seok and Nak-yeon later encounter an eccentric hunter and would-be carpenter, Yang-bae, who claims to have killed a second creature and stored its corpse in his freezer.
